    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Dashboard"

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES treats the range text as one literal record and claims FULL evidence from a potentially failed query plus truncated fallback. It does not establish what OCP denotes, resolve two physical slots/modules, handle absent adapters, map sensor origin or correlate the UI and specification.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED appropriately rejects a literal range query but incorrectly expands OCP as over-current protection and invents rail/protection/alarm semantics unsupported by this BMC sensor-page row. In server platform context, the Review layer treats OCP1/2 as presumptive OCP adapter/module positions, subject to Project confirmation, and does not import electrical fault testing.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 877/2291 accepts command/output presence without resolving the OCP acronym, two records, slot/card population, sensor source, thresholds/freshness or complete UI/spec correlation.

original_test_intent: Verify the two temperature records represented by `TEMP_OCP_1~2`—presumptively OCP adapter/module positions 1 and 2 on this server—are individually readable in Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading and have the correct slot identity, value, units, status and supported thresholds for the platform specification.
original_method: First confirm the platform-defined meaning of OCP, then resolve OCP1 and OCP2 into separate stable sensor records, bind each to its physical slot and installed adapter/module or board-local probe, and compare complete passive raw/UI fields with the approved specification under recorded card population, link/load and airflow. Preserve logs and configuration.
manual_activity: The platform owner confirms the vendor meaning of OCP, identifies both physical positions and fitted adapters, and defines whether each value comes from the card or a board-local probe. Automation can collect two resolved records and UI rows; a human resolves acronym/slot/source ambiguity and owns the verdict. No traffic load, interface change, adapter reset or electrical fault is authorized.
required_inputs: Platform definition of `OCP_1~2` and exact chassis/board/BMC/BIOS configuration
Physical OCP slot numbering and installed adapter/module FRU, PN, serial, firmware, PCIe BDF and host-interface mapping
For each sensor, the physical source and path—adapter telemetry versus board-local slot probe—and stable SDR name/number/type/entity/instance plus UI rows
Per-slot expected units, scaling/rounding, tolerance, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health, freshness and empty-slot/unavailable semantics
Recorded adapter link/traffic/power state, system load, fan mode/speeds, airflow, timestamps and any approved vendor telemetry correlation
Validated ipmitool/API/browser versions, protected authentication and pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or manual method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL or system logs; PCIe, network, thermal and BMC events are relevant context for adapter/slot telemetry.
Do not issue `sensor get 'TEMP_OCP_1~2'` unless that exact string is documented as one record. Enumerate and query OCP1 and OCP2 separately, preserving individual success/status.

Do not assume OCP means over-current protection or invent rail/fault criteria. Confirm the platform acronym and keep electrical protection testing outside this source row unless separately authorized.
Do not assume a sensor is card-internal. Bind its source to adapter identity or board-local slot placement; a host NIC temperature may corroborate only after the same FRU/BDF is proven.
Do not generate network traffic, change link or driver state, reset an adapter, alter thresholds or remove/reseat a card. Record the existing link/load/airflow state for this passive check.

Apply population-aware acceptance for empty slots, do not truncate inventory, expose passwords through `-P`, assume cipher 17 or execute the unavailable Script. Stop without automatic retry on duplicate/swapped identities, stale data or UI/OOB/FRU disagreement.
agent_execution_scope: Validate target, OCP meaning, slot/card population, sensor source, client and Script; build a two-row expected slot matrix before collection.
Retrieve OCP1 and OCP2 independently with complete SDR identity, value, units, supported thresholds, status and timestamp; capture each unchanged Dashboard and Server Health row.
Correlate every record with the physical slot and installed adapter FRU/BDF/interface and, if approved, time-aligned card telemetry under the recorded link/load/airflow state.
Preserve raw/redacted evidence and logs; perform no network stress/configuration, adapter reset/service, threshold change, automatic retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Confirm the authoritative expansion and hardware meaning of OCP for this platform and approve the slot/card/source map.
Provide per-slot threshold, tolerance, status, freshness and empty-slot acceptance plus any valid card-telemetry equivalence, and approve the collection tool/Script.
Review OCP1 and OCP2 independently and issue the formal verdict without importing unsupported over-current rail criteria or using one slot for both.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Likely unfit because tilde notation is not an IPMI wildcard and one output cannot prove two slot records. It also leaves OCP semantics and card/slot/source mapping unresolved, truncates fallback data, exposes credentials and assumes cipher support.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate the complete sensor repository, confirm the platform OCP meaning, resolve exact OCP1 and OCP2 records, query each through protected read-only access and correlate both UI rows with physical slot and installed adapter identity.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_OCP_1~2, Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading, readability/specification Criteria, generic clear text, Script URL, DeepSeek commands and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; Review resolves semantics without editing Master or adding fault/load operations.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a two-row matrix keyed by physical OCP slot and installed adapter identity, documenting each sensor source, complete raw/API and both UI fields at a recorded passive link/load state, then compare per-slot values and thresholds with the versioned platform/adaptor specification.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact chassis/board, OCP slot and adapter population, BMC/SDR/WebUI build documented by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/board, BIOS/BMC/SDR/WebUI, adapter PN/serial/firmware/driver, management client and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform OCP-slot topology and sensor map, adapter thermal specification when applicable, SDR definition, WebUI schema and Project configuration specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Resolves ambiguous range/acronym text into two population-bound adapter or slot sensors, rejects invented rail semantics and adds source/FRU/UI evidence without active network or fault stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Passive slot/card temperatures do not validate NIC traffic thermal response, throttling, link reliability, adapter reset, alarms or electrical over-current protection; an empty approved slot is not automatically a failure.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: OCP meaning, slot/card/source map, per-slot acceptance, link/load/airflow timing rules, protected tool or reviewed Script and evidence contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OCP numbering may differ among chassis/BMC/host; sensors can be card-provided or board-local; empty slots can omit records, and UI values may lag or round.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use Redfish/OEM or host adapter telemetry as an approved alternative/corroboration only with the original ipmitool method preserved, actual interface/version/source and reason recorded, engineer approval and equivalent separate OCP1/OCP2 identity, value, threshold, status and freshness coverage. A generic NIC sensor or over-current status is not automatically equivalent.
expected_evidence: Platform-approved OCP meaning, chassis/board/BMC/BIOS identity, physical slot numbering and fitted adapter PN/serial/FRU/firmware/BDF/interface inventory
Separate OCP1 and OCP2 complete raw records with stable IDs, sensor source, values, units, threshold capabilities/values, status and timestamps
Separate redacted Dashboard and Server Health evidence mapped to the same physical slots and adapter identities
Per-slot Project/adapter specification plus recorded link/traffic/power, fan and airflow state with tolerance/update-lag and optional host-telemetry comparison
Explicit empty, missing, duplicate, swapped, stale or UI/OOB/FRU disagreement disposition and pinned Script/tool security evidence
No-clear/no-write/no-network-stress/no-reset/no-retry proof, final adapter/BMC health, limitations and engineer-owned per-slot verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The acronym is underdefined, but the row consistently requests passive display/specification validation of two named temperature records. Project documentation can establish whether OCP means the expected adapter positions and their mapping, so this is readiness uncertainty rather than an irreducible source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Two passive temperature targets and the UI purpose are identifiable. OCP semantics, slot population and acceptance can be supplied by Project SPEC; missing inputs do not make the review permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes YES to PACKAGE, rejects the literal range query and adds two physical slot/card/source identities plus complete UI/spec evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its hybrid classification but corrects the unsupported over-current-protection interpretation and removes invented rail/fault semantics in favor of Project-confirmed server OCP adapter/module mapping.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces command-presence reasoning with acronym resolution, population-aware per-slot identity and source-specific evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No prior invalid draft exists for this sequence.

review_improvement: Prevents a failed literal range query and, critically, prevents an OCP adapter-temperature row from being transformed into an unrelated over-current rail test. It also prevents an empty or wrong slot from being accepted through name-only evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Within a server Sensor Page, `TEMP_OCP_1~2` more plausibly identifies Open Compute Project adapter/module locations than electrical over-current protection, but the Project must confirm the vendor acronym. Each populated position needs a separate identity tied to FRU/BDF and sensor source. The source authorizes passive readings only, so neither NIC stress nor over-current injection belongs in this review.
